summary: Youdao, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited financial results for Q1 2026. The release discloses total net revenues of RMB1.3B (US$195.4M), a 3.8% YoY increase, and basic net income per ADS of RMB0.33. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender offer, restructuring, etc.) is announced. The filing is an ordinary earnings report with no deal terms or extraordinary corporate action. It is a routine current report by a foreign private issuer and does not warrant classification as a special situation.
